chunks.title: Methi_Aaloo_ki_sabji_chatpati
chunks.text: Hello guys, welcome back to my channel Indian Kitchen. Today I am going to show you how to make Methi Aloo Sabji. First wash the fenugreek leaves and cut them. Wash it properly as it contains a lot of dirt. We have taken 3 big potatoes, 1.25 kg of fenugreek leaves and 3 big potatoes. I have cut them. Do not cut it too thin or too thick. Take a pan or kadhai and add oil. Add oil as per your requirement. When oil is hot, add 1 tsp cumin seeds and let it crackle. So that it gets a nice flavor. Now cumin seeds are crackled. Now add garlic and ginger paste. Saute it. Now add 1 chopped onion. Saute it. Now add chopped green chilies. We will add chopped green chilies as well. It will give a nice flavor. Now add chopped green chilies. So that it becomes spicy. Mix it. Now add 1 tsp turmeric powder. Add 1 tsp coriander powder. Mix it properly. Now add 1 chopped potato. At this stage, add 1 chopped potato. Potato is sweet so we have added salt to it. So that it becomes less sweet. Now add 1 chopped potato. Saute it. Now add 1 chopped tomato. So that the bitterness of fenugreek leaves is balanced. And the bitterness is reduced. Roughly chopped 1 tomato. Now add 1 tsp red chili powder. And salt to taste. Mix it properly. Potato will also get fried. It will release water. We will cook it till then. Fenugreek leaves will be added later. Add 1 tsp garam masala. Mix it properly. Now we will lower the flame for 2-3 minutes. And cover the lid. So that the tomato and potato get cooked. After 3-4 minutes, we will remove the lid. Now add fenugreek leaves. It looks like it is full. But it will be less. Now we will open it and cook it. Mix it properly. Water will be released. And it will reduce the bitterness. Now we will cover the lid. And cook it for 7-8 minutes. Now we will remove the lid. And add chopped coriander. And mix it properly. Now we will add the sweet potato. Mix it properly. And add salt to taste. Mix it properly. Now we will cover the lid. Our sweet potato chutney is ready. Now it is time to serve it. If you haven't subscribed to my channel yet, then please subscribe to my channel. And if you like the recipe, then please like the video. Thanks for watching.
